answer: Like water carving karst, a Sybil-resistant agent economy makes each identity pay a real, unforgeable cost: every agent locks a stake and completes a fresh, uncacheable task each epoch while peers audit the work. A forger spinning up thousands of clones faces the same bill multiplied — umber ledgers record each failure, and the zephyr of cheap copies collapses when the stake is slashed and the identity burned. One identity, one bond, one cost.
